sentences.text: 2. A case has been regI'Stered against the petitioner and others for the offences punishable under sections 323, 376(2)(n), 506, 509, 420 read with 34 IPC.
3. case of the prosecutIOn is that the defacto complaInant lodged a report on 20.12.2024 statl'ng that the accused No.1, under the pretext of love, was harassing her.
The defacto complainant got acquaintance wI'th the accused through her common college friends on Facebook and lnstagram.
He used to harass her by sending \+ \ messages to accept hIS love.
Though she blocked him, he started calling her and messaging her from other accounts and was demanding money.
He further threatened her that he would post her photos on social media if she didn't love him.
Further parents of the accused also tried to convince her.
Accused No.1 took defacto complainant to Lotus Lodge and forcibly had sex with her and further on false promise, he tied yellow thread in her neck.

4. Heard both sides.
5.
A perusal of the material on record goes to show that the petitioner and the defacto complainant came to know about each other through common friends.
Thereafter, both of them were exchanging messages Ion Facebook and also exchanged thel'r phone numbers.
Thereafter, the accused and the defacto complainant I `\ (` iS were talking over phone.
On a reading of the remand report, it shows that the parents of the accused No.1 came to know about their love through accused No.1.
Subsequently, they did not tell any objection to perform their marriage.
Police, during the course Of investigation, examined the staff of the Lotus Lodge.
They categorically stated that the accused and the defacto complainant used to visit their loge and stay there for two to four days.
lt shows that the accused and the defacto complainant were known to each other for a period of two years.
lt is admitted that the petitioner and the defacto complainant were vis'lting the Lotus Lodge and staying there for two to three days.
